objective: Fix BUG-005: in src/tools/rewind.ts rewindExecute step 7, add a null-check immediately after `const markerId = appendRewindMarker(pi, ctx, payload);` and BEFORE `leaveNote(...)` that returns a refusal when markerId === null, so a failed marker persist (pi.appendEntry throws OR ctx.sessionManager.getLeafId() returns null) yields a 'Mulligan: refused — ...' text and sends NO note — instead of the current silent success that tells the agent a rewind happened when nothing will be hidden. Update the one existing test that encodes the old (buggy) null→fallback-note contract, and add a new 2-case test (appendEntry throws; getLeafId returns null) asserting the refusal text + that sendMessage (the note) is NOT called + that appendEntry was attempted exactly once. Keep the full vitest suite green.
implementationSteps: Edit 1 — src/tools/rewind.ts rewindExecute step 7 (lines 463–465): immediately after `const markerId = appendRewindMarker(pi, ctx, payload);` and BEFORE `leaveNote(pi, { content: rendered, rewindId: markerId ?? toolCallId });`, insert `if (markerId === null) { return refusal("failed to persist the rewind marker (nothing will be hidden); no changes were made", granularity); }`. Reuse the existing module-local refusal() helper (~line 122) — it returns `details: { granularity }` (markerId absent by construction) and wraps the text as `Mulligan: refused — ${reason}.`. Keep the success path (leaveNote + successText + details with markerId) byte-for-byte UNCHANGED, including the `?? toolCallId` (do NOT remove it). Update the step-7 inline comment (~line 461) to note the null-check so it does not contradict the new guard.

Task A — In test/tools/rewind.test.ts makePi (~line 58), add an `appendEntryCalls` counter: declare `let appendEntryCalls = 0;` alongside `appended`/`sent`, increment it (`appendEntryCalls += 1;`) at the TOP of the `appendEntry` fake body (BEFORE the `if (opts.throwOnAppend) throw ...` line, so the throw case still counts the attempt), and expose it on the returned object as a closure getter `appendEntryCalls: () => appendEntryCalls` (NOT a bare number — a bare number would snapshot at construction). This lets the new test assert "appendEntry attempted exactly once" in BOTH the throw case (appended.length===0) and the getLeafId-null case (appended.length===1).

Task B+C — In test/tools/rewind.test.ts: REMOVE the old `describe("mulligan_rewind — leafId null fallback")` / `it("getLeafId returns null → rewindId falls back to toolCallId")` (~line 646) — its `/^Mulligan: rewound/` assertion encodes the OLD buggy contract and WILL FAIL after Edit 1. REPLACE it with one new `describe("mulligan_rewind — BUG-005: null persist result refusal")` containing TWO `it` cases. Case 1 (appendEntry throws): `makePi({ throwOnAppend: true })` + `makeCtx()`; assert firstText(res) matches `/^Mulligan: refused — failed to persist the rewind marker/` AND `.toContain("nothing will be hidden")`, `sent.toHaveLength(0)`, `appended.toHaveLength(0)` (throw before push), `appendEntryCalls() === 1`, `res.details.toEqual({ granularity: "last_tool_call_group" })`. Case 2 (getLeafId null): `makePi()` + `makeCtx({ leafId: null })`; assert the same refusal text, `sent.toHaveLength(0)`, `appended.toHaveLength(1)` (push succeeded, getLeafId null came after), `appendEntryCalls() === 1`, `res.details.toEqual({ granularity: "last_tool_call_group" })`. Reuse the existing VALID_NOTE / run / firstText helpers (NO new fakes).

Run validation: `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` then `npx vitest run test/tools/rewind.test.ts` then `npm test`. Confirm: 0 type errors; rewind.test.ts fully green (the removed old test no longer fails, the 2 new cases pass, the loose never-throws throwOnAppend test still passes); the full suite green (692+ passed, 2 skipped, 0 newly broken). If any OTHER pre-existing test fails, it is unrelated to this change — investigate but do NOT widen the edit beyond step 7 + rewind.test.ts.

successCriteria.description: src/tools/rewind.ts rewindExecute step 7: an `if (markerId === null) return refusal("failed to persist the rewind marker (nothing will be hidden); no changes were made", granularity);` guard exists immediately after `const markerId = appendRewindMarker(pi, ctx, payload);` and BEFORE `leaveNote(...)`.

On a null persist, the returned text is exactly `Mulligan: refused — failed to persist the rewind marker (nothing will be hidden); no changes were made.` and `pi.sendMessage` (the note) is NOT called (sent.length === 0).
On a null persist, `res.details` is `{ granularity }` with NO markerId field (refusal() helper reused as-is; no helper change).

The non-null success path is byte-for-byte unchanged: `leaveNote(pi, { content: rendered, rewindId: markerId ?? toolCallId })` (the `?? toolCallId` kept) → successText(...) → `details: { granularity, k, ledger, markerId }`.
The old `mulligan_rewind — leafId null fallback` test (test/tools/rewind.test.ts ~line 646, asserting `/^Mulligan: rewound/` for getLeafId:null) is REMOVED/REPLACED — it encoded the buggy contract.

A new `describe("mulligan_rewind — BUG-005: null persist result refusal")` with TWO cases is added: (A) appendEntry throws → refusal + no note + appended.length===0 + appendEntryCalls===1; (B) getLeafId null → refusal + no note + appended.length===1 + appendEntryCalls===1.
makePi is extended with an `appendEntryCalls` closure getter (incremented before the throw) so 'appendEntry attempted exactly once' is provable in the throw case where appended.length===0.
No BUG-004 logic (countRewindMarkers, checkpointExists, the getBranch() reads) and no BUG-008 logic (src/tools/audit.ts renderAuditReport Suggestion line) is modified.
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json passes with zero errors (strict mode).
npm test is fully green (692+ passed net, 2 skipped, 0 newly broken).
The step-7 inline comment (~line 461) is updated to mention the null-check so it does not contradict the new guard.
